mentions.name: TinyGo MIDI Theremin firmware
mentions.description: This TinyGo firmware runs on a cheap Adafruit board combined with Gaudi Lab's OpenThereminV3 shield to provide MIDI theremin capabilities for live music performance. The source is available on GitHub for anyone to play with.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also just (sort of) finished a TinyGo version of firmware that runs on a cheap Adafruit board in combination with Gaudi Lab's OpenThereminV3 shield to provide MIDI theremin capabilities for live music performance. That one is available at https://github.com/intermernet/theremin if anyone wants to play with it.
mentions.author: Intermernet
